description:
We are looking for a Senior Automation QA Engineer to develop and maintain two interconnected projects: a Python-based test automation framework and an AI-powered QA automation solution.

Our team ensures quality across the gaming platform, internal back-office systems, and customer-facing websites.

We value autonomy, ownership, and practical solutions. Meetings are kept to a minimum - one weekly stand-up and additional discussions when needed.

Technical Skills
- Strong Python engineering skills and hands-on experience independently developing test automation frameworks;
- Solid experience with API and UI test automation;
- Good understanding of software architecture, code quality, and maintainability;
- Strong analytical thinking, debugging, and code review skills.

AI & Automation
- Practical experience using OpenAI Codex or Claude Code in development workflows;
- Ability to design and implement AI-powered automation solutions;
- Understanding of MCP and its applications for integrating AI with testing tools and infrastructure;
- Ability to critically evaluate and validate AI-generated solutions.

Testing & Ownership
- Solid understanding of testing principles and experience-based testing;
- Ability to identify where automation provides real value;
- Ability to work independently, take ownership, and make technical decisions;
- Languages: Ukrainian (Proficient), English (B2).


Responsibilities

- Develop and evolve two interconnected projects: test automation and AI-powered QA solutions;
- Build integrations between AI tools, testing infrastructure, and internal services;
- Improve test coverage, reliability, and overall QA efficiency;
- Analyse test results, investigate failures, and identify root causes;
- Collaborate with developers to improve product quality and maintainability.


Technology Stack
- Python (pytest)
- Playwright
- Postman
- Docker
- Git
- Jenkins (CI/CD)
- Kibana
- Jira
- TestRail / Testmo
- OpenAI Codex / Claude Code
- Model Context Protocol (MCP)

Why Join Us?

🎰 Be part of the international iGaming industry – Work with a top European solution provider and shape the future of online gaming;

💕 A Collaborative Culture – Join a supportive and understanding team;

💰 Competitive salary and bonus system – Enjoy additional rewards on top of your base salary;

📆 Unlimited vacation & sick leave – Because we prioritize your well-being;

📈 Professional Development – Access a dedicated budget for self-development and learning;

🏥 Healthcare coverage – Available for employees in Ukraine and compensation across the EU;

🫂 Mental health support – Free consultations with a corporate psychologist;

🇬🇧 Language learning support – We cover the cost of foreign language courses;

🎁 Celebrating Your Milestones – Special gifts for life’s important moments;

⏳ Flexible working hours – Start your day anytime between 9:00-11:00 AM;

🏢 Flexible Work Arrangements – Choose between remote, office, or hybrid work;

🖥 Modern Tech Setup – Get the tools you need to perform at your best;

🚚 Supported Relocation Opportunities – Explore opportunities to relocate to one of our company hubs with financial assistance.
